sources.use: A block adopts its final operand value/type and evaluates that operand in value context. This supports no separate function boundary, but says nothing about debit units.
Let initializers are place contexts; value expressions can require temporaries. Copy values in identifier/operand flows remain owners. Comparison operands are evaluated left to right.
Identifier patterns bind by copying or moving. This motivates explicit A/B initializer-to-binding edges.
Definition-site local resolution captures c; expansion-local at bindings are separate. Macro syntax expansion creates no function or closure owner.
Function return semantics include a designated function output location and control transfer. Ordinary expression blocks do not add that function boundary.
The official signature has self and msg:&str parameters. Each message source/received argument requires an accounting disposition even on Some.

qualification: Current official Reference/std documentation reviewed for language/API semantics. No compiler-version-specific layout or generated instructions measured.
